patthana15.55:1.1: kusalaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca na dassanena pahātabbahetuko na kusalo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā. ekaṃ,
patthana15.55:2.1: dassanena pahātabbahetukaṃ akusalaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca na dassanena pahātabbahetuko na akusalo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā. tīṇi.
patthana15.55:3.1: na dassanena pahātabbahetuko na abyākato dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā. dve, (abyākata vāre sabbattha paccaya vasena gaṇetabbaṃ.) na bhāvanāya
